publicationFrequency.frequencyDescription: First Wednesday after day 1 of every month. The exact weekday can vary due to public holidays. Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of 3 months between the publication date and published data.

expectedPublicationDelay.delayDescription: Because of reporting delays, there is a gap of at least 90 day(s) between the publication date and published data.

temporalVariables.columnDescription: Temporal information of the value specified in the property 'valueCategory'.
temporalVariables.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of temporal value in the property 'temporal'.

georegion.columnDescription: Geographical unit of the data record.
georegion.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of geographical unit in the property 'georegion'.

agegroup.columnDescription: Age range brackets used for grouping.
agegroup.typeColumnDescription: Specifies the type of agegroup in the property 'agegroup'.

type.columnDescription: Type specification used for grouping. Distinguishes between different types of disease stages. Classification of the disease distinguishes between 'acute', 'chronic' (symptomatic), and 'unclassifiable' (other asymptomatic) hepatitis C infections.

value.description: Represents the value defined by the property 'valueCategory' within the given temporal unit and grouping.

valueYearCumSum.description: Cumulative sum of the property 'value' within a year.

valueMean3y.description: Right-aligned, rolling 3-year average of the property 'value' within the grouping described in the property name.

pop.description: Population number within the given temporal unit and grouping.

prct.description: Proportion of the entry in the property 'value' as percent within the given temporal unit and grouping.

incValue.description: Incidence value within the given temporal unit and grouping. Based on non-rounded figures of value and pop. For the grouping 'type', the population count corresponds to the CHFL population

incValueMean3m.description: Right-aligned, rolling 3-month mean of the property 'incValue' within the grouping described in the property name.

deltaValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'value' comparing the current year to the last one.

deltaIncValue.description: Absolute difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

incValuePrctChange.description: Percentage difference in the metric 'incValue' comparing the current year to the last one.

valueMean5y.description: Right-aligned, rolling 5-year average of the property 'value'.

dataComplete.description: Can data be assumed to be complete (few late reportings to be expected)?

trend.description: Indicates a trend of an entry with respect to previous entries. The trend is calculated using a poisson glm with a log-link with a right-aligned window of size 4 for the temporal_type year. For data by year the trend is adjusted by population size.
